Content: The text describes an event known as Shays' Rebellion.

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This question has two parts.)`
The information below describes protections provided by Article `1` of the Massachusetts Constitution and Section `1` of the `text(Fourteenth)` Amendment to the U.S. Constitution.

:box:`bbtext(Article 1 of the Massachusetts Constitution)`

All people are born free and equal. Citizens of Massachusetts are guaranteed the ability to do the following:

• enjoy and defend their lives and freedoms
• own personal property
• seek happiness and safety

:box:`bbtext(Section 1 of the Fourteenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution)`

All people born in the United States, or who go through the naturalization process, are U.S. citizens. U.S. citizens are guaranteed that states cannot do the following:

• make laws that go against their rights
• take away their life, freedom, or property without due processn
• deny them equal protection of the law
How do the protections described in the information `bbtext(most)` benefit citizens?

A.Choice: by allowing citizens to run for office

B.Choice: by creating rules for citizens to vote

C.Choice: by defining the individual rights of citizens

D.Choice: by granting the government power over its citizens
